versions.changelog:
Magneto Skill Master v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive skill for safely downloading, auditing, and installing external agent skills from GitHub/Gitee into WorkBuddy.
- Implements a mandatory secure six-step workflow: repo locating, temporary download, security audit (P0/P1/P2 grading), WorkBuddy format adaptation, user-level install, dependency setup & verification.
- Includes detailed guidance on venv management, Windows path compatibility, frontmatter correction, and Chinese character encoding fixes.
- Special focus on skills related to bids, document generation, and automation; ensures audit transparency before use.
- Automated in response to user prompts like "download skill from GitHub" or "add a skill to WorkBuddy".
- Summarizes all key status and risks to user after install, including source, audit conclusions, install path, and usage tips.
